body: Founder: 'i need you to put the stats of the items in the readme and suggested heroes.' Added the full 24-item ARENA_ITEMS catalog as a real markdown table (slot/cost/AD/HP/MP/Armor/Move Speed bonuses) -- previously only described in prose. Added a 4-hero 'suggested for new players' section spanning Tank/Fighter/Marksman/Support (MnM, Duck, Gary, He Xiangu), picked for kit simplicity -- no clone management, blink mind-games, or stealth timing. Docs-only. REDGARDEN 3698202 (+ CHANGELOG same commit range).
title: S170-199: item stats table + suggested heroes in README
